summary: go-sqlite3 1.14.28 → 1.14.52 is a large "patch": 24 releases, bundled SQLite 3.49 → 3.53.4, minimum Go raised to 1.21 (ldcli is on 1.25), many bind/row-path rewrites, and an opt-in statement cache. ldcli reaches the driver only through database/sql in internal/dev_server/db, events_db, and db/backup (the Backup API). Reachable changes (behavior_changes_reachable is true): per-row cancellation goroutines removed (QueryEvents and other QueryContext calls), sqlite3_clear_bindings after reset, and SQLite engine changes under json_each, timestamps, and the ALTER TABLE migration. The statement-cache changes (1.14.51/52 schema probe and flush) are opt-in and not enabled by ldcli.

changelog.notes: SQLite 3.51–3.53 amalgamations, min Go 1.21, opt-in statement cache, bind fast-path rewrites, 'return error instead of silently ignoring unsupported bind types' (#1422)
no per-row goroutines for query cancellation; sync.Map handle table; flush statement cache on schema change
eager first step replaces the schema probe for cached statements (statement cache is opt-in)

findings.text: #1422 (unsupported bind types now error) only affects values that reach the driver without database/sql conversion; ldcli binds strings, []byte/json.RawMessage, int, and time.Time through database/sql, so it is unreachable.
